product.name: KALLAX
product.introText: KALLAX shelving unit, white, 77x147 cm (2x4 compartments). Assembly instructions AA-2703433-1. Tools: hammer and the Allen key. Two people recommended for standing it up.
product.partsSummary: 1x Allen key,  1x Bottom,  4x Divider,  22x Dowel,  8x Screw,  1x Shelf 1a,  1x Shelf 1b,  1x Shelf 2a,  1x Shelf 2b,  1x Shelf 3a,  1x Shelf 3b,  2x Side,  1x Top

steps.title: Side and bottom
steps.text: Work on a soft surface with the unit lying on its back. Join one long side panel and the bottom panel with 2 screws, using the Allen key. Turn the screws by hand - never with a power drill.

steps.title: First shelf
steps.text: Hammer 2 dowels into the side panel and push the first shelf half onto them.

steps.title: First divider
steps.text: Hammer 2 dowels into the bottom panel and push the first divider onto them, against the shelf.

steps.title: Second shelf half
steps.text: Put the matching shelf half against the other side of the divider.

steps.title: Second divider
steps.text: Hammer 2 dowels into the end of the divider and push the next divider onto them.

steps.title: Second shelf
steps.text: Hammer 2 dowels into the side panel, push the next shelf half onto them and add its matching half.

steps.title: Third divider
steps.text: 2 dowels into the divider end, then the next divider.

steps.title: Third shelf
steps.text: 2 dowels into the side panel, then the last pair of shelf halves.

steps.title: Last divider
steps.text: 2 dowels into the divider end, then the last divider.

steps.title: Dowels for the second side
steps.text: Hammer 8 dowels: 2 into the free end of each shelf half and 2 into the top end of the last divider.

steps.title: Second side panel
steps.text: Push the second long side panel onto the dowels and fix it to the bottom panel with 2 screws.

steps.title: Top panel
steps.text: Stand the unit up (two people). Put the top panel onto the dowels and fix it with 4 screws. Always anchor KALLAX to the wall (page 27) - wall fixings are not included.
